full_judgment: 2. The plaintiffs' case, in short, is that Ahammad Ali and Torab Ali were the original owners of 90 decimals of land in Khatian No.59, which was auction-purchased by Zamindar Babu Sotish Charan Laha, from whom Ayesha Khatun took settlement vide kabuliyat dated 07.11.1945 and on the same date she sold 21 decimals of land to Ohider Rahman and Abul Bashar and the remaining 69 decimals were transferred to her son Gura Mia and the sons of first wife of Torab Ali, and delivered possession thereof. The plaintiffs purchased land from the rightful owners which has been detailed in schedule `Kha' in the plaint. The plaintiff of Title Suit No.16 of 1985 obtained a decree dated 29.04.1987 without serving any notice upon the plaintiff Nos.1-3 and without impleading plaintiff No.4. The plaintiffs are in possession of the suit land. The defendant No.13 who was plaintiff in Title Suit No.16 of 1985 though has no possession but on the basis of the aforesaid collusive decree claiming title in the suit land and hence the plaintiff after obtaining the decree passed in aforesaid Title Suit No.16 of 1985 filed the instant suit.
